visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Swap In Place, No Second Array
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A second array holds the result, then a loop fills in the zeros. Do the same job in place by swapping each non-zero value into the next free position. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Swapping each non-zero value with the element at pos pushes the zeros back as a side effect, so no extra array and no fill loop are needed. It uses constant extra memory.
